instruction:
This CAE task passes through three applications: AutoCAD -> SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. For this workflow, use the AutoCAD 2024, SOLIDWORKS 2025, and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop as the three stages of this workflow. No init files are provided; start from blank files.

Handoff requirement: use the design token EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_07. In AutoCAD, add a readable label containing EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_07 and AUTOCAD_TO_SOLIDWORKS on a CHAIN layer in stage1_profile.dxf. In SolidWorks, keep EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_07, FROM_stage1_profile.dxf, and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS encoded in the part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage2_geometry.step contains them. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_07 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage2_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In AutoCAD, draw a closed 90 x 70 mm outline on OUTLINE and four D5 holes on HOLE at (10,10), (80,10), (10,60), and (80,60) mm. On FIN_REF draw eight lines from Y=12 to Y=58 mm at X=17, 25, 33, 41, 49, 57, 65, and 73 mm. Save stage1_profile.dxf.
2. In SolidWorks, import the DXF in millimeters. Create one solid with a 90 x 70 x 5 mm base, four through holes, and eight fins centered on FIN_REF. Each fin is 2 mm thick, 46 mm long, and 19 mm high above the base top, for 24 mm overall height. Export stage2_geometry.step.
3. In Abaqus/CAE, import the STEP into Model-DxfFinnedSinkThermal. Define Aluminum conductivity 0.17 W/(mm*C), assign a solid section, and create steady heat-transfer step Step-Thermal. Set HEAT_PAD on the base bottom and CONVECTION_SURFACES on all other exposed faces. Use first-order DC3D4 or DC3D8 elements and no more than 1000 nodes. Apply HeatFlux-Base = 0.02 W/mm^2, and FilmCondition BC-Convection with h=2.0e-5 W/(mm^2*C) and sink temperature 25 C. Submit Job-DxfFinnedSinkThermal and wait for completion.

4. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DxfFinnedSinkThermal.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DxfFinnedSinkThermal.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

First use AutoCAD to create the DXF profile, then use SolidWorks to import the DXF and export the STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; AutoCAD 2024 (English): `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024 - English.lnk`.
